youtube.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Search Media by Meaning
youtube.description:
EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google's 740M-parameter multimodal embedding model for mapping text, code, images, audio, and video into a shared vector space. That can help a search app retrieve media from a text query; it is not a chatbot or a complete search product. Google released it under Apache 2.0 and targets on-device inference. The phone clip is Google's own AI Edge Gallery demo, not our independent benchmark. Facts checked 13 October 2026.
Sources: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/embeddinggemma-2/ · https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/embeddinggemma/model_card_2 · https://huggingface.co/google/embeddinggemma-2
